Hi Ezra — thanks for the details and the report, that helps a lot. I pulled together three packaging paths below with rough timing and commercial signals. Attaching a short proposal PDF so you can circulate to procurement.

1) Gradual upgrade (recommended):
   - Start with a Dedicated pilot (reserved capacity) for the most latency-sensitive endpoints (2–4 weeks to provision).
   - Add Private control plane + VPC peering as an add-on before full cutover (2–6 weeks depending on networking).
   - Keep most integrations on hosted for lower-cost workloads.
   - Benefits: minimal disruption, staged risk reduction.

2) All-in private lift:
   - Full Private deployment (VPC + on-prem option) with dedicated pool sized to 750M tokens/mo.
   - Longer lead time (6–10 weeks) and separate onboarding.
   - Recommended for PHI-first customers.

3) Feature-split (cost-conscious):
   - Keep Core (hosted) for non-PHI traffic + add a small Dedicated pool for PHI endpoints.
   - Bundle only the features you need (VPC, SLA upgrade, audit logs).

Commercial highlights:
- Bundles vs add-ons: Dedicated capacity, SLA-backed latency, and premium support are typically part of the "Dedicated" bundle. VPC/private control plane and HSM/KMS integrations are add-ons in most proposals.
- Term: standard 12-month commit; we can offer limited termination flexibility with a ramp-down clause (requires legal review).
- Discount bands: for a commit at your scale we typically land between 8–15% depending on onboarding credits and timing.

Next steps: if you confirm which path you prefer, Ben can run a pricing model and I’ll schedule an infra checklist call with our Private deployment engineer.

Attachements: clarity-proposal-v1.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

Thanks — Jasmine

Jasmine — thanks for the summary. My guidance:

- Approve up to 10% standard discount for a 12-month commit at that scale.
- Offer a $20k onboarding credit (one-time) instead of pushing to 15% off list; credits preserve ARR math.
- If Clarity signs within 30 days, add a 6% early-sign bonus (stackable; communicated as a limited-time incentive).
- Promise the pilot safety net: canary routing + automatic fallback to hosted model variant for the first 30 days. KV cache persistence can be included as a pilot SLA but mark it as "operational best-effort" until full Private deployment.

If they request termination flexibility beyond our standard ramp-down clause, route to legal — we can consider a mid-term exit with a partial true-up.

Ben — please prepare two clean quote options: (A) Dedicated pilot -> full Private in 3 phases with 10% discount + $20k credit; (B) Feature-split (smaller Dedicated pool) with 12-month commit and 7% discount. Include the DocuSign link and explicit cancellation/ramp-down language.
